content: Alitretinoin is a medication used to treat skin lesions associated with Kaposi's sarcoma. It works by inhibiting the growth of Kaposi's sarcoma cells. While it is primarily prescribed for this condition, it may also be used for other purposes. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information. Alitretinoin is available as a topical gel and is typically applied twice daily. However, your doctor may adjust the frequency of application based on your response to the treatment. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Use alitretinoin exactly as directed. Do not use more or less of it, or apply it more frequently than prescribed. This medication helps control Kaposi's sarcoma lesions but does not cure them. It may take at least two weeks of consistent use to notice any benefits, and for some patients, it may take 8 to 14 weeks to see results. Do not discontinue the medication without consulting your doctor. To apply alitretinoin, follow these steps: 1.
